case_name: Public servant taking gratification other than legal remuneration in respect of an official Act
facts: The Public servant taking gratification other than legal remuneration in respect of an official Act

If a person not expecting to be in office obtains a gratification by deceiving others into a belief that he is about to be in office, and that he will then serve them, he may be guilty of cheating, but he is not guilty of the offence defined in this section.
holding: The punishment is imprisonment which shall be not less than three years but which may extend to seven years and shall also be liable to fine.
